title: Class C license.
officialText: An applicant for a class C special hoisting machine operator license shall have at least two years experience within the three years prior to application under the direct and continuing supervision of a licensed hoisting machine operator and have satisfactorily passed a practical examination in the operation of equipment for which such license is to be issued.
